{"metadata":{"description":"Chrome sidebar extension that lets DeepSeek Harness operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required. 一款 Chrome 侧边栏扩展程序，可让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控您的浏览器，无需视觉能力。","id":"gh:1324996099","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-browser","slug":"omdsh-dev/dsh-browser","topics":["browser-automation","chrome-extension","coding-agent","cordis","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Chrome sidebar extension that lets DeepSeek Harness operate your browser directly, no vision capabil"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ities required. 一款 Chrome 侧边栏扩展程序，可让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控您的浏览器，无需视觉能力。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh Browser Control [](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/Lum1104/dsh-browser?ref=badge)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Connect DeepSeek Harness to the Chrome or Firefox tabs you are already using. The model can read pag"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"e content, operate controls, navigate, and manage tabs while preserving your login state, session, a"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"nd cookies. A side panel or sidebar provides the conversation UI."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"`dsh` is DeepSeek AI's open-source, plugin-based agent harness. This repository provides a companion"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" browser bridge plugin and Chrome/Firefox MV3 extension as one standalone pnpm workspace."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Pages become structured text with a numbered inventory of interactive elements. Tools address elemen"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ts by number or selector; `browser_screenshot` captures the controlled tab's viewport after approval"},{"id":"p6s3","text":". The side panel also accepts PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF attachments when the host advertises image su"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"side panel also accepts PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF attachments when the host advertises image support."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> [!IMPORTANT]
> The workspace targets the latest public dsh release, currently pinned to 0.2.1-rc.5"},{"id":"p7s2","text":". Older DSH releases are not supported."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Quick install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Performance"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Core capabilities"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Capability | Tool | Notes |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Read page | `browser_snapshot` | Structured text snapshot: title, URL, main text, numbered control"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"s, and masked form fields; `delta: true` returns only changes, `frame` reads one iframe, and `query`"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" locates any element by text/selector/role and returns its selector |
| Click | `browser_click` | Cl"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ick or double-click by index or selector; supports mouse buttons and modifiers |
| Text | `browser_t"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ype` | React/Vue-compatible input; `replace` clears the field first, and `mode` selects caret insert"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ion or per-character key events |
| Press keys | `browser_press` | Single keys or chords (`modifiers"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"`); `action: down/up` holds a key across calls and `repeat` repeats it |
| Scroll | `browser_scroll`"},{"id":"p14s8","text":" | Scroll the page or selected iframe up, down, to the top, or to the bottom |
| Clipboard | `browse"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"r_clipboard` | `write` puts text/HTML on the system clipboard; `paste` delivers it as a paste event "},{"id":"p14s10","text":"or a real platform shortcut |
| Files | `browser_upload` | Attach local files to an `input[type=file"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"]` (Chrome) |
| Navigate | `browser_navigate` / `browser_open_tab` / `browser_back` / `browser_forwa"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"rd` / `browser_reload` | Navigation inside the controlled tab, or open a URL in a new tab and follow"},{"id":"p14s13","text":" it (`active:false` keeps the current tab in front) |
| List tabs | `browser_list_tabs` | List acces"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"sible tabs with stable IDs, titles, URLs, window/index metadata, and active/controlled state |
| Fol"},{"id":"p14s15","text":"low tab | `browser_follow_tab` | Bind later browser tools to a tab returned by `browser_list_tabs`; "},{"id":"p14s16","text":"it stays in the background unless `activate: true` |
| Close tab | `browser_close_tab` | Close a tab"},{"id":"p14s17","text":" returned by `browser_list_tabs` |
| Read region | `browser_get_text` | Lazy-loaded or partial page "},{"id":"p14s18","text":"text |
| Wait for stability | `browser_wait` | Page-load and render-settle detection |
| Send images"},{"id":"p14s19","text":" | `session.prompt` / `session.attachment` | Host-capability-gated image drafts, image-only prompts,"},{"id":"p14s20","text":" and durable history previews |
| Quote a selection | side panel composer | Text you highlight in th"},{"id":"p14s21","text":"e page appears in the composer and is sent with your next message as fenced, attributed page content"},{"id":"p14s22","text":"page appears in the composer and is sent with your next message as fenced, attributed page content |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Why this design"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Your real browser, not a headless copy**: the model works in the page you already have open, ret"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"aining logins, sessions, and cookies.
- **A text-first page interface**: numbered controls, stable I"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"Ds across snapshots, delta updates, and masked sensitive values make pages operable without screensh"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ots; user-attached chat images use dsh's separate multimodal message path.
- **Pointing instead of d"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"escribing**: highlight the passage you mean and the side panel quotes it, so "explain this" needs no"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" page tour. The quote is captured only while a panel is open, and nothing is sent until you send the"},{"id":"p17s7","text":" message.
- **A narrow privacy boundary**: passwords and payment-card values are always rendered as "},{"id":"p17s8","text":"`••••` and never leave the page.
- **A guarded bridge**: authenticated handshakes protect remote con"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"nections, privileged gateway methods reject non-loopback callers, and the extension binds tools to o"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"ne user-controlled tab."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- The bridge path sits outside the `/api` trust boundary and performs its own bearer-token authentic"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ation.
- Local Chrome extension origins retain zero-configuration loopback access; Firefox origins a"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"re per-install UUIDs and must present the bearer token.
- Privileged gateway methods such as `settin"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"gs.*`, `credentials.*`, and `host.open*` reject non-loopback sources.
- Text snapshots mask password"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" and payment-card values. Screenshots capture visible pixels without field masking and require appro"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"val unless unrestricted control is enabled; page sharing set to `off` blocks screenshots under restr"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"icted control. Screenshots and attached chat images use dsh's durable attachment service. Developer "},{"id":"p19s8","text":"tools have a separate high-privilege consent gate.
- When work begins, the assistant binds to the ac"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"tive tab (at prompt submission, or at the first direct browser-tool call). If you switch tabs manual"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"ly, later browser actions pause and the side panel asks whether the assistant should stay on the ori"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"ginal page or follow the current one, and offers "jump back to the assistant page" to move your own "},{"id":"p19s12","text":"tab back to the assistant's page. Choosing the original page permits background operation; apart fro"},{"id":"p19s13","text":"m that button the extension never silently retargets or changes your visible tab. Closing the contro"},{"id":"p19s14","text":"lled tab also pauses tools until you explicitly select the current page.
- Text you highlight is cap"},{"id":"p19s15","text":"tured only while a side panel is open and page sharing is not `off`, and never from password or paym"},{"id":"p19s16","text":"ent-card fields. It stays inside the extension until you send the message, is dropped when you dismi"},{"id":"p19s17","text":"ss it or its page navigates or closes, and reaches the model inside the same untrusted-content bound"},{"id":"p19s18","text":"ary as page snapshots — including its source title and URL, which the page also controls.
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
